# Experience

My work experience spans quite different research environments: from basic and
discovery research, through high-throughput genomics at a sequencing
centre, to building and leading a bioinformatics core facility within
a translational biomedical research institute.


## Translational research & bioinformatics core facility

::: {.experience-entry}

<div class="experience-period">2021–2025</div>

### Head of Bioinformatics Unit

**Josep Carreras Leukaemia Research Institute (IJC), Barcelona**

I built and led the institute's bioinformatics core facility, supporting
research groups across leukemia, immunology and other biomedical
research areas.

My role combined scientific bioinformatics with team leadership and
research support, as well as developing the processes, workflows and
infrastructure needed to provide a sustainable bioinformatics service.

The work ranged from individual research projects to developing some of the 
broader bioinformatics environment within the institute, including data management, 
reproducible workflows, computational infrastructure, training and collaboration 
with experimental scientists and clinicians.

:::


## High-throughput genomics

::: {.experience-entry}

<div class="experience-period">2013–2019</div>

### Postdoctoral Fellow

**National Centre for Genomic Analysis (CNAG-CRG), Barcelona**

I worked in a sequencing-centre environment on large-scale genomics and
epigenomics projects, with a particular focus on DNA methylation and
whole-genome bisulfite sequencing.

Much of my work was connected to the BLUEPRINT Epigenome project and
the study of DNA methylation during hematopoietic differentiation and
in leukemia. I also worked on projects in other biomedical research
areas such as Inflammatory Bowels Disease (IBD).

Working at a sequencing centre brought together biological research
with the computational challenges of processing large volumes of
sequencing data. My work included data analysis, computational methods
and the development of pipelines and software, including contributions
to **gemBS** and **gemBSR**.

:::


## Basic & discovery research

::: {.experience-entry}

<div class="experience-period">2012–2013</div>

### Postdoctoral Fellow

**RIKEN Omics Science Center, Yokohama**

I worked on the computational analysis of transcription and transposable
element activity during early zebrafish development, integrating CAGE
and ChIP-seq data.

:::


::: {.experience-entry}

<div class="experience-period">2009–2012</div>

### Postdoctoral Fellow

**Centre for Genomic Regulation (CRG), Barcelona**

I worked on transcriptomics and alternative splicing as part of the ENCODE project, developing and applying computational methods for large-scale RNA-seq analysis.

This included work on **GRAPE**, a computational pipeline developed for
the analysis of RNA-seq data within ENCODE.

:::


## Education

::: {.experience-entry}

<div class="experience-period">PhD · 2008</div>

### PhD in Biology

**University of Canterbury, Christchurch, New Zealand**

My doctoral research focused on microsatellite evolution, combining
molecular biology with computational approaches to study short tandem
repeats in yeast.

It was during my PhD that I increasingly moved towards computational
biology and bioinformatics.

:::
